code:
FROM python:3.10-slim

WORKDIR /srv

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir \
    -r requirements.txt
caption: Requirements first, so the slow layer is cached.

code:
RUN useradd --create-home appuser
COPY app.py .
COPY models/ models/
USER appuser

EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "app:app",
     "--host", "0.0.0.0",
     "--port", "8000"]
caption: Non-root user, exec-form CMD, listening on all interfaces.
